channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jerry Colangelo | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jerry Colangelo from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Keldon Johnson on Jerry Colangelo
item.description:
“Then (Team USA managing director)Jerry (Colangelo) came up to me and he kind of broke the news to me,”

Keldon Johnson on Jerry Colangelo, Jul 18, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Robert Sarver on Jerry Colangelo
item.description:
Sarver continued:

“And so I did and met Jerry Colangelo a couple of weeks later and we kind of shook hands on a deal maybe two or three weeks after that. It happened a lot faster than I thought it would happen, it just came together quick.”

Robert Sarver on Jerry Colangelo, Jun 16, 2020. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Patrick Ewing on Jerry Colangelo
item.description:
Ewing said on The Dan Patrick Show.

“So I called Jerry Colangelo, and he was great to be able to get me two replacement medals.”

Patrick Ewing on Jerry Colangelo, May 7, 2020. Source: SportsNet New York.

item.title: David Griffin on Jerry Colangelo
item.description:
“We had a built-in advantage because Jerry Colangelo was the chairman of that board. We knew from the very beginning what was likely to come about. So we were able to plan for longer than everybody else,”

David Griffin on Jerry Colangelo, Nov 1, 2018. Source: The Ringer.

item.title: Sam Hinkie on Jerry Colangelo
item.description:
Another fromSam Hinkie, on Jerry Colangelo:

“If I’m anything, I’m a learner, so I’ve asked a whole lot of questions, which has been fun... So we’ve had many hours where can sit together and talk about where we’ve been, and where we are,and where we’re going.”

Sam Hinkie on Jerry Colangelo, Jan 13, 2016. Source: Twitter @brianseltzer.

item.title: Rudy Gay on Jerry Colangelo
item.description:
Gay had considered Colangelo’s call, his invitation, to participate in the program with which he played a reserve role in the gold medal of the 2010 World Championships, but he ultimately declined.

“Mr. Colangelo respected that I couldn’t be involved with it this summer because I had a lot of things going on in the summer,”

Rudy Gay on Jerry Colangelo, Nov 5, 2013. Source: RealGM.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Jerry Colangelo, Mike Krzyzewski
item.description:
“It wasn’t something I expected. Jerry Colangelo and Mike Krzyzewski called and I thought it would be a great opportunity to learn. I am excited to be here. Any time you have the opportunity to be around great coaches and great players, you have to take it. And these are your opponents, I think you learn a lot from them, too. I followed Team USA from afar and was very curious to see what the inner workings are here.”

Tom Thibodeau on Jerry Colangelo, Mike Krzyzewski, Jul 24, 2013. Source: Sporting News.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Jerry Colangelo, Mike Krzyzewski
item.description:
“I am honored that Jerry Colangelo and Mike Krzyzewski have asked me to join the USA Basketball National Team coaching staff,”

Tom Thibodeau on Jerry Colangelo, Mike Krzyzewski, Jun 10, 2013. Source: USA Basketball.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Jerry Colangelo
item.description:
“Jerry Colangelo did a great job bringing the staff together. They're in a great position and I'm excited about their future. They have to continue to build on what they started. It would be good for someone to experience it. I'm grateful for my six and a half years.”

Nate McMillan on Jerry Colangelo, May 23, 2013. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Dwight Howard on Jerry Colangelo
item.description:
Ken Berger:Dwight on convo with Colangelo:

“I told him I'm committed to being on the team. ... Nothing else matters.”

Dwight Howard on Jerry Colangelo, Jan 16, 2012. Source: Twitter.
